description: SEBI circular HO/47/11/11(1)2026-MRD-POD3/I/13804/2026: ETF price bands move to a dynamic band around the previous close (para 5.1: widening needs only trades at 9.90% from the base and a cooling-off; no breadth test).
NSE circular NSE/CMTR/76101 (ref 122/2026) implements the SEBI price-band circular (dated 1 Sep 2026).
Price-band regime prev_close starts: band base = previous close, +/-10% widening to +/-20% (DECISIONS D5). Last session of the old NAV(T-2) base was 2026-09-04.

BSE caution about the premium of international ETFs, reported after the close on a Friday, so the first session that could react is Monday 2026-09-28. Affected symbols and the wording of the caution are to be filled from the primary document.
Motilal Oswal Nasdaq 100 Fund of Funds stops accepting new SIP registrations, citing exhausted overseas investment limits.
Addendum dated 2024-12-24: Motilal Oswal Nasdaq 100 Fund of Funds pauses existing SIPs from 2025-01-05, citing exhausted overseas investment limits.
